entities.name: PMID:25073668
observations: 2014 retrospective tandem-colonoscopy study of factors associated with missed colorectal polyps.
Included 395 patients and 2,068 polyps; elective repeat colonoscopy occurred from August 2011 through August 2013 for polyp resection.

entities.name: Polyp miss rates
observations: Patient-level miss rate was 59.2% (234/395), and polyp-level miss rate was 27.9% (578/2,068).

entities.name: Missed-polyp risk factors
observations: Afternoon examination was associated with missed polyps (OR 1.632, P=0.046).
Polyps smaller than 5 mm (OR 4.595, P<0.001) and 5–10 mm (OR 3.447, P<0.001) were more likely to be missed.
Flat morphology (OR 2.406, P<0.001), sessile morphology (OR 1.768, P=0.002), and left-colon location (OR 1.391, P=0.007) were associated with missed polyps.
Endoscopist experience and patient characteristics were not significantly associated with missed-polyps rates.
